about: kino's built-in sound library (backend/sound-library.mjs). Files are not in git: each source downloads on first use and must match its sha256. Measured once with ffmpeg (ebur128): seconds, lufs (integrated), peak (true peak dBFS); a music drop (musicDrop, scripts/sound-library-measure.mjs) is the strongest rise after 8 s of 6 LU or more in short-term loudness that lands within 3 LU of the loudest and 3 LU over the median, so a soft swell is no drop. A reverse sound is the source's first `reverse` seconds played backwards with a fade in. Music licenses: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/licenses/ ; sound pages name CC0.
